description: The plot illustrates the WER during fine-tuning of the Whisper model for the "small" type with different amounts of weights. The x-axis is labeled "epoch", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 6, and has tick labels at intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled "WER", has a linear scale, ranges from 25 to 42.5, and has tick labels at intervals of 2.5. There are four lines in the plot: "small_AdaLoRA_int4" (solid orange line with diamond markers) starts at 30 and ends at 26, decreasing steadily; "small_AdaLoRA_int8" (dashed orange line with square markers) starts at 32.5 and ends at 27.5, decreasing steadily after a slight increase from epoch 0 to 1; "small_int4" (dotted orange line with circle markers) starts at 35 and ends at 29, showing a fluctuating trend with a peak at epoch 2; "small_int8" (dash-dotted orange line with triangle markers) starts at 30 and ends at 25, decreasing steadily.
